thread:
zoe: FYI: coffee curfew proposal  can we do 'no grinder after 6:30pm'? Some neighbours complained about the late buzz. quick thumbs? :coffee:

marcus: +1 from me. my 7pm espresso is life but also fine moving earlier.

tanya: sad :cry: but also ok. maybe make it 'be mindful after 6:30' instead of strict curfew.

rookie: question: does this affect the midnight snack runs? asking for a friend. :raising_hand:

ops-bot: Survey posted: coffee_curfew_preference. results so far: yes_strict=2, yes_courteous=1, no=1. Kitchen inventory: espresso_beans=0.5kg, oat_milk=3.

eva: can we also add a tiny sign: "Grinder = noisy. Please close kitchen door when grinding after 6pm". helps with neighbours but not huge enforcement.

zoe: I can make a simple door sign and print tomorrow. also tagging facilities to remind them about sound insulation follow-up.

marcus: unrelated note: someone microwaved fish last week. can we have a polite note: "No smelly food in shared kitchen"?

tanya: yes please. and also "label personal items". so many mystery jars.

rookie: i'll design two 1-line signs tonight and drop them on the printer. emoji-friendly.

ops-bot: Action items created: sign_grinder_door, sign_no_smelly_food, sign_label_items. Assigned to rookie. ETA: tomorrow morning.

zoe: thanks team. if curfew poll leans strict, we'll post final note by Friday. in the meantime, please be kind to the kitchen and neighbours :)
